zh: 一次操作只花 x，与区间长度无关，所以把增量一直延伸到数组末尾不会更贵。想一想这样的后缀加法会改变哪些相邻差。
对后缀整体加 x，只改变后缀起点与前一个元素之间的差，其余相邻差都不变。而每个下降处 power[i−1]>power[i]，都必须靠从 i 开始的增量补齐下降量。
遍历每对相邻元素，累加 max(0, power[i−1]−power[i])，用 64 位整数输出总和即可。
en: One operation costs only x regardless of the range length, so extending an increment all the way to the end of the array is never more expensive. Think about which adjacent differences such a suffix increment changes.

Adding x to a whole suffix changes only the difference between the start of the suffix and the element before it; all other adjacent differences stay the same. Every drop with power[i-1] > power[i] must be covered by increments that start at i.
Walk over every adjacent pair, add max(0, power[i-1] - power[i]) to the total, and print the sum as a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Add up every adjacent drop max(0, power[i−1]−power[i]).

## Proof of Correctness

Each drop boundary must be made up by increments of ranges that start on its right side, and one range can produce a positive improvement on at most one starting boundary, so the sum of the drops is a lower bound. At each drop position, increasing the whole suffix by that drop fixes the boundary without changing any later adjacent difference, which achieves exactly the lower bound.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n) (to store the input).
